duas.transliteration: Inna lillaahi maa akhadha, wa lahu maa a'taa, wa kullun 'indahu bi-ajalim-musammaa, faltasbir wal-tahtasib.
duas.swahili: Hakika ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu kile Alichokitwaa, na ni Vyake kile Alichokitoa, na kila kitu Kwake kina muda maalum uliopangwa; basi subiri na utarajie malipo kutoka kwa Allah.
duas.english: Truly to Allah belongs that which He has taken, and to Him belongs that which He has given, and with Him everything has an appointed time; so be patient and anticipate Allah's reward.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #159, Sahih al-Bukhari 1284, Sahih Muslim 923
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno bora na ya faraja ya kisheria ya kumliwaza ndugu, rafiki au jirani aliyefiwa na mpendwa wake.
duas.virtue_en: The definitive Islamic condolence offering serenity, acceptance of Qadar, and patient hope for eternal reunion.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Mvua Wakati wa Ukame (Istisqa)
duas.title_en: Seeking Rain During Drought (Istisqa)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعًا، نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummasqinaa ghaythan mugheetham-maree'am-maree'aa, naafi'an ghayra dhaarri, 'aajilan ghayra aajil.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tunyeshee mvua yenye kuokoa, yenye manufaa na rutuba, yenye kheri isiyo na madhara, ya haraka bila ya kuchelewa.
duas.english: O Allah, shower upon us a saving rain, abundant, productive, beneficial without harm, promptly and without delay.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa wakati nchi au jamii inapokumbwa na ukame na upungufu wa maji.
duas.virtue_en: Invokes beneficial rainfall during periods of drought, crop failure, and scarcity.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Upepo Mkali na Tufani
duas.title_en: When Fierce Wind or Storm Blows
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayrahaa, wa khayra maa feehaa, wa khayra maa ursilat bih, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri maa feehaa, wa sharri maa ursilat bih.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba kheri ya upepo huu, na kheri ya vilivyomo ndani yake, na kheri ya kile ulichotumwa nacho; na ninajikinga Kwako na shari yake, na shari ya vilivyomo ndani yake, na shari ya kile ulichotumwa nacho.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, the good that is in it, and the good with which it was sent; and I seek refuge in You from its evil...
duas.virtue_sw: Upepo mkali unaweza kubeba rehma au adhabu; dua hii huomba kheri yake na kuzuia madhara yake.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against destruction from fierce storms, asking for its mercy rather than wrath.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwenye Wasiwasi Katika Imani
duas.title_en: For One Experiencing Whispers or Doubts in Faith
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أصابه وسواس في الإيمان
duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ، هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ.
duas.transliteration: Aamantu billaahi wa Rusulih. Huwal-Awwalu wal-Aakhiru wadh-Dhaahiru wal-Baatinu wa Huwa bikulli shay'in 'Aleem.
duas.swahili: Nimemwamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mitume Wake. Yeye ndiye wa Mwanzo na ndiye wa Mwisho, na ndiye Aliye Dhahiri na ndiye Aliye wa Siri; Naye ni Mjuzi wa kila kitu.
duas.english: I believe in Allah and His Messengers. He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is Knower of all things.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #136, Sahih Muslim 134, Abu Dawud 5110
duas.virtue_sw: Hufukuza papo hapo wasiwasi na maswali ya shaka yanayopandikizwa moyoni na shetani.
duas.virtue_en: Dispels Satanic whisperings, existential doubts, and spiritual anxieties.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Kinga dhidi ya Madeni na Utumwa
duas.title_en: For Relief from Heavy Debts and Economic Dependency
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummakfinee bi halaalika 'an haraamik, wa aghninee bi fadhlika 'amman siwaak.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nitosheleze kwa riziki Yako ya halali nisiihitaji haramu Yako, na unitajirishe kwa fadhila Zako nisiwe na haja na yeyote asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful so that I do not need what is forbidden, and enrich me with Your bounty so that I need no one besides You.
duas.virtue_sw: Hata kama mtu angekuwa na deni kubwa kama mlima wa Uhud, Mwenyezi Mungu atamfungulia njia ya kulilipa kwa baraka ya dua hii.
duas.virtue_en: Even if one had debt equivalent to a mountain, Allah facilitates its repayment through this prayer.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Adam na Hawa ya Kutubu
duas.title_en: Supplication of Adam and Eve for Forgiveness
duas.title_ar: دعاء آدم وحواء عليهما السلام في التوبة
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa dhalamnaa anfusanaa wa in lam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tumejidhulumu nafsi zetu; na kama Hutusamehe na kuturehemu, bila shaka tutakuwa miongoni mwa waliopata hasara.
duas.english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno ya toba aliyofundishwa Nabii Adam na Mwenyezi Mungu mwenyewe na akamsamehe; kielelezo kikuu cha unyenyekevu.
duas.virtue_en: The words of repentance revealed to Adam by Allah, securing complete divine forgiveness.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Musa ya Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_en: Supplication of Prophet Musa Seeking Forgiveness
duas.title_ar: دعاء موسى عليه السلام في الاستغفار
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi nimejidhulumu nafsi yangu, basi nisamehe.
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua fupi lakini nzito inayomfanya Mwenyezi Mungu amsamehe mja papo hapo.
duas.virtue_en: A concise yet immense plea that earned immediate forgiveness from Allah for Prophet Musa.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Nuh ya Kutaka Kinga na Rehema
duas.title_en: Supplication of Prophet Nuh for Protection and Mercy
duas.title_ar: دعاء نوح عليه السلام في الاستعاذة والاستغفار
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee a'oodhu bika an as'alaka maa laysa lee bihee 'ilm, wa illaa taghfir lee wa tarhamnee akum-minal-khaasireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Mimi ninajikinga Kwako nisije nikakuomba yale nisiyo na ilimu nayo; na kama Hutanisamehe na kunitendea rehema, nitakuwa miongoni mwa wenye kukhasirika.
duas.english: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge; and unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.
duas.virtue_sw: Inamfundisha mja adabu ya kuomba dua sahihi na kutegemea rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu daima.
duas.virtue_en: Cultivates profound etiquette in supplication and utter reliance on Allah's pardon.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mtume ya Istighfar Katika Kila Kikao
duas.title_en: The Prophet's Repeated Seeking of Forgiveness in Gatherings
duas.title_ar: استغفار النبي في المجلس الواحد مائة مرة
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa tub 'alayya, innaka Antat-Tawwaabur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu nisamehe na upokee toba yangu; hakika Wewe ndiwe Mwingi wa kupokea toba, Mwenye kurehemu daima.
duas.english: My Lord forgive me and accept my repentance; surely You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Masahaba walikuwa wakimuhesabia Mtume ﷺ akirudia maneno haya mara 100 katika kikao kimoja tu.
duas.virtue_en: The Companions counted the Prophet ﷺ repeating this supplication 100 times in a single sitting.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Msamaha wa Madhambi Makubwa na Madogo
duas.title_en: Comprehensive Plea for Expiation of All Sins
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaahal-'Adheemal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, wa atoobu ilayh.
duas.swahili: Ninamwomba msamaha Mwenyezi Mungu Aliye Mkuu, ambaye hapana mola ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu, na ninatubu Kwake.
duas.english: I seek forgiveness of Allah the Magnificent, besides Whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent unto Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Mwenye kusema hivi atasamehewa madhambi yake hata kama alikimbia vitani.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites this will be forgiven their sins even if they had fled from the battlefield.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Uongofu, Ucha Mungu na Kujitosheleza
duas.title_en: Seeking Guidance, Piety, Chastity and Contentment
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-hudaa, wat-tuqaa, wal-'afaafa, wal-ghinaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba uongofu, na ucha-Mungu, na usafi wa nafsi (kujiepusha na machafu), na utajiri wa moyo (kutosheka).
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency (contentment of the heart).
duas.virtue_sw: Dua fupi inayojumuisha kheri zote za dini na dunia kwa maneno manne mepesi.
duas.virtue_en: One of the most comprehensive prayers gathering all goodness of both worlds in four words.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Mwisho Mwema (Husnul Khatimah)
duas.title_en: Supplication for a Beautiful Blessed Ending (Husn al-Khatimah)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الْخَاتِمَةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ الْخَاتِمَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ أَعْمَارِنَا أَوَاخِرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ أَعْمَالِنَا خَوَاتِيمَهَا، وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِنَا يَوْمَ نَلْقَاكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka husnal-khaatimah, wa a'oodhu bika min soo'il-khaatimah. Allaahummaj'al khayra a'maarinaa awaakhirahaa, wa khayra a'maalinaa khawaateemahaa, wa khayra ayyaaminaa yawma nalqaak.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba mwisho mwema wa maisha yangu, na ninajikinga Kwako na mwisho mbaya. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, fanya sehemu bora ya umri wetu iwe ni mwishoni mwake, na matendo yetu bora yawe ya kukhitimisha, na siku yetu bora iwe siku tutakapokutana na Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for a good and righteous conclusion to my life, and seek refuge from an evil end. Make the best of our lives its end, the best of our deeds the concluding ones...
duas.virtue_sw: Mambo hutegemea miisho yake; dua hii inalinda imani ya mja mpaka pumzi yake ya mwisho.
duas.virtue_en: Actions are judged by their conclusions; preserves the believer's faith until the final breath.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kutubu Madhambi ya Siri na Dhahiri
duas.title_en: Pleading Pardon for All Sins, Minute and Immense
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lee dhanbee kullah, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa aakhirah, wa 'alaaniyatahu wa sirrah.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nisamehe madhambi yangu yote: madogo na makubwa, ya kwanza na ya mwisho, yaliyo dhahiri na yaliyo ya siri.
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me all my sins: the minor and the major, the first and the last, the open and the hidden.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyokuwa akiisoma Mtume ﷺ akiwa amesujudu; haisazi kosa lolote bila kufutwa.
duas.virtue_en: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ in prostration; leaves no fault unpardonned.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupiga Chafya na Majibu Yake
duas.title_en: Upon Sneezing and Responding to Sneezing
duas.arabic: الْعَاطِس: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. الْمُسْتَمِع: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ. رَدُّ الْعَاطِس: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaah -> Yarhamukallaah -> Yahdeekumullaahu wa yuslihu baalakum.
duas.swahili: Mwenye kupiga chafya husema: 'Alhamdulillaah' (Sifa njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu). Aliyesikia anamjibu: 'Yarhamukallaah' (Mwenyezi Mungu akurehemu). Kisha aliyepiga chafya anajibu: 'Yahdeekumullaahu wa yuslihu baalakum' (Mwenyezi Mungu awaongoze na atengeneze mambo yenu).
duas.english: Sneezer says: Alhamdu lillah. Listener replies: Yarhamukallah. Sneezer responds: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.
duas.virtue_sw: Haki mojawapo kati ya haki sita za Muislamu kwa Muislamu mwenzake; inaleta upendo na afya.
duas.virtue_en: One of the six mutual rights of Muslims; fosters goodwill, community, and divine mercy.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kumuombea Aliyefunga Ndoa (Maharusi)
duas.title_en: Congratulating the Newly Married Couple
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ.
duas.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka, wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakumaa fee khayr.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akubariki, na ashushe baraka juu yako, na awaunganishe ninyi wawili katika kila lililo la kheri.
duas.english: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite both of you in goodness.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah tukufu ya kumuombea kila mtu anayeingia kwenye ndoa badala ya maneno ya kimila.
duas.virtue_en: The prophetic standard of congratulating new marriages, invoking enduring blessing and harmony.

duas.title_sw: Dua Kabla ya Tendo la Ndoa
duas.title_en: Before Marital Intimacy
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah, Allaahumma jannibnash-shaytaana, wa jannibish-shaytaana maa razaqtanaa.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tuepushe na shetani, na umwepushe shetani na kile Utakachoturuzuku (mtoto).
duas.english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from that with which You provide us.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #191, Sahih al-Bukhari 6388, Sahih Muslim 1434
duas.virtue_sw: Ikiwa watakadiriwa kupata mtoto kupitia tendo hilo, shetani hatamdhuru kamwe mtoto huyo katika maisha yake yote.
duas.virtue_en: If a child is conceived, Satan will never be able to harm that child throughout their entire life.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuingia Sokoni au Eneo la Biashara
duas.title_en: When Entering the Market or Shopping Mall
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyee wa yumeet, wa Huwa hayyun laa yamoot, biyadihil-khayr, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee hana mshirika; ufalme ni Wake na sifa njema zote ni Zake; Yeye ndiye Ahuishaye na Afishaye, Naye Yu Hai hafi kamwe; mkononi Mwake mna kheri yote, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Mwenye uwezo mkubwa.
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and praise...
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma anapoingia sokoni anaandikiwa mema milioni moja (1,000,000), anafutiwa madhambi milioni moja, na anainuliwa daraja milioni moja Peponi.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it entering a market is rewarded with one million good deeds, one million sins erased, and raised one million ranks.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kulipa Deni kwa Aliyekukopesha
duas.title_en: When Repaying a Debt to a Lender
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أدى دينه إلى صاحبه
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ.
duas.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fee ahlika wa maalik, innamaa jazaa'us-salafil-hamdu wal-adaa'.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akubariki katika familia yako na mali yako; kwani hakika malipo ya mkopo ni kushukuru na kulipa vizuri.
duas.english: May Allah bless you in your family and wealth; the only reward for borrowing is sincere praise and prompt repayment.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #195, An-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah #300
duas.virtue_sw: Huimarisha uaminifu, udugu na baraka ya mali baina ya wakopeshaji na wakopaji.
duas.virtue_en: Fosters trust, brotherhood, and financial barakah between creditors and debtors.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuona Mtu Aliyepatwa na Mtihani au Ulemavu
duas.title_en: Upon Seeing Someone Afflicted with Trial or Disability
duas.title_ar: دعاء من رأى مبتلى في دينه أو دنياه
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee 'aafaanee mimmab-talaaka bih, wa fadh-dhalanee 'alaa katheerim-mimman khalaqa tafdheelaa.
duas.swahili: Sifa zote njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ameniepusha na yale aliyokutahini nayo, na akanifadhilisha juu ya wengi katika aliowaumba kwa ubora mkubwa.
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who has spared me from that with which He tested you, and favored me over much of what He created.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtu anayeisoma kwa siri anapomwona mtu mwenye tatizo basi yeye binafsi ataepushwa na mtihani huo maisha yake yote.
duas.virtue_en: Recited privately; whoever recites it upon witnessing affliction will be protected from that tribulation throughout life.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupanda Mlima na Kushuka Bondeni
duas.title_en: When Ascending an Incline or Descending a Valley
duas.title_ar: التكبير عند الصعود والتسبيح عند الهبوط
duas.arabic: عِنْدَ الصُّعُودِ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. عِنْدَ النُّزُولِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Wakati wa kupanda: Allaahu Akbar. Wakati wa kushuka: Subhaanallaah.
duas.swahili: Unapopanda eneo la juu (mlima, ghorofa, ndege inapopaa) unasema: 'Allaahu Akbar'. Na unaposhuka (bonde, ngazi) unasema: 'Subhaanallaah'.
duas.english: When ascending: Allahu Akbar. When descending: SubhanAllah.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah aliyokuwa akiifuata Mtume ﷺ na masahaba safarini ili kukumbuka ukuu wa Allah pale mtu anapokuwa juu.
duas.virtue_en: Prophetic sunnah during travels; humbling oneself when elevated and glorifying Allah when descending.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kufika Mji au Kijiji Kipya Katika Safari
duas.title_en: Upon Entering a New Town or City
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i wa maa adhlaln, wa Rabbal-aradeenas-sab'i wa maa aqlaln, wa Rabbash-shayaateeni wa maa adhlaln, wa Rabbar-riyaahi wa maa dharayn, as'aluka khayra haadhihil-qaryah, wa khayra ahlihaa, wa khayra maa feehaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri ahlihaa, wa sharri maa feehaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola wa mbingu saba na yale yaliyoyafunika, na Mola wa ardhi saba na yale yaliyoyabeba, na Mola wa mashetani na yale waliyoyapoteza, na Mola wa pepo na yale yaliyoyapeperusha; nakuomba kheri ya kijiji/mji huu, na kheri ya watu wake, na kheri ya yaliyomo ndani yake; na ninajikinga Kwako na shari yake, na shari ya watu wake, na shari ya yaliyomo ndani yake.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry...
duas.virtue_sw: Hukuhakikishia usalama, ulinzi na mapokezi mazuri wakati wowote unaposafiri na kuingia eneo au nchi mpya.
duas.virtue_en: Guarantees safety, divine hospitality, and protection from harm when entering any foreign city or territory.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kurudi Kutoka Safarini
duas.title_en: Upon Returning from a Journey
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Aayiboona, taa'iboona, 'aabidoona, li-Rabbinaa haamidoon.
duas.swahili: Tumerudi tukiwa ni wenye kutubu, wenye kufanya ibada, na kwa Mola wetu Mlezi tukiwa ni wenye kumsifu na kumshukuru.
duas.english: We return repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutamkwa na msafiri anapoanza kuikaribia nyumba yake au mji wake baada ya safari ndefu au fupi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited as the traveler approaches home, concluding the voyage with devotion, humility and gratitude.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwenye Kupokea Habari ya Furaha na Neema
duas.title_en: Upon Receiving Pleasing News or Good Tidings
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أتاه أمر يسره ونعمة
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee bi ni'matihee tatimmus-saalihaat.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye kwa neema Zake mambo mema yote yanakamilika.
duas.english: Praise be to Allah through Whose favor all good things are accomplished.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alikuwa akisema maneno haya kila alipofikishiwa habari au jambo lenye kumfurahisha.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ uttered this whenever something pleased him, attributing all success to Allah.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupokea Jambo Lisilopendeza au Huzuni
duas.title_en: Upon Encountering Displeasing News or Setback
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi 'alaa kulli haal.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu katika kila hali.
duas.english: Praise be to Allah in all circumstances.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alikuwa akisema hivi anapokutana na changamoto au jambo lenye kuumiza, akionyesha kuridhika kamili na mipango ya Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Exemplifies complete submission and contentment with Allah's decree during setbacks.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuingia Makaburini (Kusalimia Wafu)
duas.title_en: When Visiting the Graveyard
duas.title_ar: دعاء زيارة القبور والسلام على أهلها
duas.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ.
duas.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum daara qawmim-mu'mineen, wa innaa in shaa'Allaahu bikum laahiqoon, nas'alullaaha lanaa wa lakumul-'aafiyah.
duas.swahili: Amani iwe juu yenu enyi watu wa makazi ya waumini; na hakika sisi, Mwenyezi Mungu akipenda, tutajiunga nanyi; tunamuomba Mwenyezi Mungu atupe sisi nanyi salama na afya.
duas.english: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of this dwelling of believers; and we, if Allah wills, will soon join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya kuwasalimia maiti na kuwaombea maghfira, na inamkumbusha mtembeleaji kuhusu ukweli wa mauti na maandalizi ya Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Honors the departed believers with prayers while serving as a profound reminder of mortality and the hereafter.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Kuchinja Mnyama
duas.title_en: When Slaughtering an Animal
duas.title_ar: الدعاء عند ذبح الأضحية أو الذبيحة
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi wallaahu Akbar, Allaahumma minka wa lak, Allaahumma taqabbal minnee.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkubwa zaidi. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, (mnyama huyu) anatoka Kwako na ni kwa ajili Yako; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, takabali kutoka kwangu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, from You and for You; O Allah, accept this from me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #221, Sahih Muslim 1967, Abu Dawud 2795
duas.virtue_sw: Inafanya uchinjaji kuwa ibada halali, yenye baraka, na inayokubaliwa mbele ya Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Sanctifies the slaughter as an act of pure worship and devotion to Allah alone.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Kinga dhidi ya Tabia Mbaya na Matamanio
duas.title_en: Seeking Refuge from Immorality and Evil Desires
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الأَخْلاَقِ، وَالأَعْمَالِ، وَالأَهْوَاءِ، وَالأَدْوَاءِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min munkaraatil-akhlaaq, wal-a'maal, wal-ahwaa', wal-adwaa'.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ninajikinga Kwako na tabia mbaya zilizokataliwa, na matendo maovu, na matamanio mabaya ya nafsi, na maradhi mabaya.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, wicked deeds, corrupt desires, and severe illnesses.
duas.virtue_sw: Kinga imara dhidi ya kupotoka kimaadili na kufuata matamanio yanayomuangamiza mtu.
duas.virtue_en: Potent defense against moral corruption, harmful impulses, and damaging inclinations.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Mapenzi ya Allah na Wanaompenda
duas.title_en: Asking for Allah's Love and the Love of Those Who Love Him
duas.title_ar: سؤال محبة الله ومحبة من يحبه
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ حُبَّكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ نَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمِنَ الْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka hubbak, wa hubba may-yuhibbuk, wal-'amalal-ladhee yuballighunee hubbak. Allaahummaj'al hubbaka ahabba ilayya min nafsee wa ahlee wa minal-maaa'il-baarid.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba mapenzi Yako, na mapenzi ya yule anayekupenda Wewe, na amali itakayonifikisha kwenye kupata mapenzi Yako. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, yafanye mapenzi Yako yawe yenye kupendeza zaidi kwangu kuliko nafsi yangu, familia yangu, na kuliko maji baridi (wakati wa kiu kikali).
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the deed that will bring me to Your love. O Allah, make Your love dearer to me than myself, my family, and cold water.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Dawud aliyokuwa akiifanya mara kwa mara; huleta upendo wa dhati wa kimungu moyoni.
duas.virtue_en: The supplication of Prophet Dawud cultivating genuine divine love above all earthly desires.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kumaliza Kusoma Qur'ani Tukufu (Khatm al-Quran)
duas.title_en: Upon Completing the Quran (Khatm al-Quran)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنَا بِالْقُرْآنِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا إِمَامًا وَنُورًا وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً، اللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنَا مِنْهُ مَا نَسِينَا، وَعَلِّمْنَا مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْنَا، وَارْزُقْنَا تِلاَوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا حُجَّةً يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummarhamnaa bil-Qur'aan, waj'alhu lanaa imaaman wa nooran wa hudan wa rahmah. Allaahumma dhakkirnaa minhu maa naseenaa, wa 'allimnaa minhu maa jahilnaa, warzuqnaa tilaawatahu aanaa'al-layli wa atraafan-nahaar, waj'alhu lanaa hujjatan yaa Rabbal-'aalameen.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, turehemu kwa baraka ya Qur'ani, na Uifanye iwe kiongozi wetu, na nuru, na mwongozo, na rehema kwetu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tukumbushe kutoka kwayo yale tuliyoyasahau, na utufundishe yale tusiyoyajua, na uturuzuku kuisoma nyakati za usiku na ncha za mchana, na Uifanye iwe hoja ya kututetea Siku ya Kiyama, Ewe Mola wa walimwengu wote.
duas.english: O Allah, have mercy upon us through the Quran, and make it for us a guide, a light, a direction, and a mercy...
duas.reference: Al-Baghawi in Sharh as-Sunnah, Ad-Da'awat li-Ibn al-Mubarak
duas.virtue_sw: Dua mashuhuri ya kumalizia usomaji wa Qur'ani; wakati wa kumaliza Qur'ani ni miongoni mwa nyakati ambazo dua hujibiwa kwa wingi.
duas.virtue_en: A revered prayer upon completing the Quran, asking for its guidance, intercession and divine mercy.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Nuru Katika Kila Kitu
duas.title_en: Comprehensive Supplication for Divine Light in All Aspects
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي قَبْرِي نُورًا، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيَّ نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورًا، وَفِي عِظَامِي نُورًا، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَأَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaj'al lee fee qalbee nooraa, wa fee qabree nooraa, wa bayna yadayya nooraa, wa min khalfee nooraa, wa 'an yameenee nooraa, wa 'an shimaalee nooraa, wa min fawqee nooraa, wa min tahtee nooraa, wa fee sam'ee nooraa, wa fee basaree nooraa, wa fee sha'ree nooraa, wa fee basharee nooraa, wa fee lahmee nooraa, wa fee damee nooraa, wa fee 'idhaamee nooraa. Allaahumma a'dhim lee nooraa, wa a'tinee nooraa, waj'alnee nooraa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nijaalie nuru moyoni mwangu, na ndani ya kaburi langu nuru, na mbele yangu nuru, na nyuma yangu nuru, na kuliani kwangu nuru, na kushotoni kwangu nuru, na juu yangu nuru, na chini yangu nuru, na katika masikio yangu nuru, na katika macho yangu nuru, na katika nywele zangu nuru, na katika ngozi yangu nuru, na katika nyama yangu nuru, na katika damu yangu nuru, na katika mifupa yangu nuru. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, niongezee nuru kuu, na unipe nuru, na unifanye mimi niwe nuru.
duas.english: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my grave, light before me, light behind me, light on my right, light on my left, light above me, light below me, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light in my hair, light in my skin, light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my bones. O Allah, magnify light for me, bestow light upon me, and make me light.
duas.virtue_sw: Hujaza maisha ya muumini nuru ya mwongozo hapa duniani, ndani ya kaburi, na juu ya Sirat Siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Illuminates the believer's life in this world, in the grave, and across the bridge of Sirat in the Hereafter.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuondoa Chuki na Kinyongo Moyoni
duas.title_en: Purifying the Heart from Grudge, Envy and Ill-Will
duas.title_ar: دعاء سلامة الصدر وطهارة القلب من الغل
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالإِيمَانِ وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلاًّ لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَؤُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa wa li ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillal-lilladheena aamanoo Rabbanaa innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tusamehe sisi na ndugu zetu waliotutangulia katika imani, wala Usiweke katika nyoyo zetu chuki au kinyongo chochote dhidi ya wale walioamini; Mola wetu Mlezi, hakika Wewe ni Mpole sana, Mwenye kurehemu daima.
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Full of Pity, Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutakasa roho, huleta amani na upendo safi baina ya Waislamu, na huondoa sumu ya chuki na uhasama.
duas.virtue_en: Purifies the heart from grudges, uniting believers in genuine mutual love and serenity.
